# CCMAF Skills — Workspace (`ccmaf-skills-workspace`)

The safety disciplines every workspace agent needs: reversible system changes with a change journal, mail, web and tool output treated as data rather than instructions, bounded unattended scheduled runs, and authoring CCMAF-App workspace kits.

**Audience:** Anyone running Claude as an agent on their own machine — install alongside core for any workspace type.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-workspace@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.

## Skills (4)

| Skill | What it covers | Reference docs |
|---|---|---|
| [`safe-system-changes`](skills/safe-system-changes/SKILL.md) | Protocol for changing a machine: plan/dry-run, restore point, per-change confirm, change journal, verify, revert. Windows first. | 6 |
| [`scheduled-run-discipline`](skills/scheduled-run-discipline/SKILL.md) | Unattended scheduled runs: bounded contract, idempotent steps, lock, run log and summary, reported failures, no destructive defaults. | 6 |
| [`untrusted-input-handling`](skills/untrusted-input-handling/SKILL.md) | Mail, web pages, docs and tool output are data, not instructions: spot prompt injection, confirm content-suggested actions, report it. | 6 |
| [`workspace-kit-authoring`](skills/workspace-kit-authoring/SKILL.md) | Author CCMAF-App workspace kits: type.json manifest, persona CLAUDE.md, safety tier, allow/ask/deny profile, scaffold, schedules, review. | 6 |
